LESSON: LETTER FORMATION

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.6: Letter formation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Letter formation. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate ability to form letters correctly in and out of class.
2. Have pleasure in letter formation activities in and out of class. 39 letter formation rhymes as they write letters in air and on the sand. the edges of letter outlines and cutting out the letters. and drop activities that enhance eye- hand coordination using digital devices. could practise various letter formation activities. dots to form letters. demonstrating letter formation and practise writing letters. rhymes as they write letters. activities on letter formation movements; beginning with the starting point followed by successive movements until the end.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate ability to form letters correctly in and out of class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate ability to form letters correctly in and out of class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Have pleasure in letter formation activities in and out of class. 39 letter formation rhymes as they write letters in air and on the sand. the edges of letter outlines and cutting out the letters. and drop activities that enhance eye- hand coordination using digital devices. could practise various letter formation activities. dots to form letters. demonstrating letter formation and practise writing letters. rhymes as they write letters. activities on letter formation movements; beginning with the starting point followed by successive movements until the end.

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Letter formation.
2. Explain Letter formation to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Letter formation.
4. Show that you can: Demonstrate ability to form letters correctly in and out of class.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Letter formation. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Letter formation important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Demonstrate ability to form letters correctly in and out of class.
2. Have pleasure in letter formation activities in and out of class. 39 letter formation rhymes as they write letters in air and on the sand. the edges of letter outlines and cutting out the letters. and drop activities that enhance eye- hand coordination using digital devices. could practise various letter formation activities. dots to form letters. demonstrating letter formation and practise writing letters. rhymes as they write letters. activities on letter formation movements; beginning with the starting point followed by successive movements until the end.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
